questions.prompt: With Golden State down 2–1 in the 2022 Finals, how many points did Stephen Curry score in Game 4?

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Curry scored 43 points and had 10 rebounds in a 107–97 win to even the series 2–2.

funFacts.text: Curry played through pain after Al Horford fell on his leg during a loose-ball scramble late in Game 3.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Curry was injured late in the fourth when Horford fell on his leg while chasing a loose ball.

funFacts.text: Andrew Wiggins helped win the rebounding battle with a career-best Finals night on the glass.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Andrew Wiggins added 17 points and a career-high 16 rebounds

funFacts.text: Steve Kerr benched Draymond Green at key moments of the fourth quarter in favor of Kevon Looney.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Steve Kerr benched him for parts of the fourth quarter, while Looney remained on the floor

questions.prompt: How many rebounds per game did Dennis Rodman average for the 1995–96 Bulls?
questions.note: 14.9 a night, while scoring just 5.5 points.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Rodman averaged 5.5 points and 14.9 rebounds per game

funFacts.text: Rodman's scoring average was just 5.5 a night, illustrating how little his value depended on scoring points.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Rodman averaged 5.5 points and 14.9 rebounds per game

funFacts.text: Chicago acquired Rodman from the San Antonio Spurs in the offseason before its historic run.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: the Bulls acquired controversial All-Star forward and rebound specialist Dennis Rodman from the San Antonio Spurs

funFacts.text: Rodman had already won four rebounding titles when he joined Chicago.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: a nine-year veteran and four year rebounding champion

questions.prompt: Jerry West forced overtime in Game 3 of the 1970 Finals with a buzzer-beater from how many feet?
questions.context: 1970 NBA Finals · Game 3 · at New York

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: hit a desperation buzzer-beating 60-foot shot to tie it at 102 and force OT

funFacts.text: West's miracle shot counted for only two because the NBA had not yet adopted the three-point line.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: It counted only for two points, as only the ABA had a three-point shot at the time

funFacts.text: Moments earlier, Dave DeBusschere had given New York a late lead, setting up West's desperation heave.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Dave DeBusschere made a shot with three seconds left to give New York a 102–100 edge

funFacts.text: The Knicks still won that overtime game despite West's heroics, holding the advantage in the series.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: the Knicks were able to win, 111–108

questions.prompt: At what overall pick did Denver draft Christian Braun in 2022?
questions.context: Denver Nuggets · 2022 NBA draft · first round
questions.note: 21st overall; Braun was a rookie on the Nuggets' 2023 championship squad.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: 1 | 21 | Christian Braun | SG | United States | Kansas

funFacts.text: Braun joined Denver from the University of Kansas, where he had played college basketball.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: 1 | 21 | Christian Braun | SG | United States | Kansas

funFacts.text: As a rookie in the Finals, Braun appeared in all five games off the bench and averaged 16.4 minutes.
Denver also obtained the draft rights to Peyton Watson in a deal with Oklahoma City on the same draft night.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Draft rights to Peyton Watson (No. 30)
